name: Jean-Pierre Tremblay
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport finance was somewhat unconventional. After earning his MBA, he spent several years in corporate accounting, but the thrill of the race always called to him. He began volunteering at local karting events, offering his financial expertise to teams in need. This led to a part-time role managing the books for a regional karting series, and eventually, he landed a full-time position with the Junior Kart Team. 

Jean-Pierre is known for his meticulous approach to financial management. He believes that every dollar counts, especially in the competitive world of motorsport. He's a stickler for detail and expects accurate reporting from everyone on the team. His demanding nature is balanced by a genuine commitment to the team's success; he understands that financial stability is crucial for long-term performance. His ability to find cost-saving opportunities without compromising performance has made him an invaluable asset to the Junior Kart Team.

physical.description: Jean-Pierre is of average height with a slightly stocky build.

quirks: Always carries a lucky loonie in his pocket during race weekends.
Insists on using a vintage adding machine for initial calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when reviewing financial reports.
